high_level_description: The image depicts the Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib), a prominent Sikh religious site located in Amritsar, India. The temple is characterized by its golden dome and intricate architecture, which is reflected beautifully in the clear waters of the sacred pool surrounding it. Golden Temple: The main structure on the right side of the image is the Golden Temple, which is entirely covered in gold leaf. It features multiple domes and minarets, with a central dome that is particularly prominent. The temple's design includes ornate carvings and detailed mosaics,
